children.counts: Count 1 to 6 to complete each step cycle.
children.game_version: Form an opening chain where dancers connect in a cross-handhold and take turns acting as the line leader.

seniors.counts: Counted in a 6-step cycle over 2/4 meter.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the six-step rhythm using seated foot taps in a 2/4 meter while holding hands in a cross hold.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the six-step sequence at a reduced stride length while maintaining the basket-weave hold.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Maintain a moderate tempo with small, controlled steps.

learning_units.description: Execute the six-step lateral sequence in 2/4 meter with a basket-weave hold.

social_formats.description: Line dance with basket-weave handhold led and ended by male dancers, with women joining after initiation.

movement_profile.footwork: Six steps to the dance, similar to Sta Tria.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Open line or chain; men start the dance, women join later; leader and end dancer must be male.
movement_profile.partnering: Non-partnered line dance connected via basket-weave hold.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Do not place a female dancer at the absolute front (leader) or end position of the line.

music_profile.sound_description: Music set in a 2/4 time signature suitable for opening Greek social gatherings.

basic_steps: Form a line holding hands in a basket weave (cross) hold, led by a male dancer.
Execute the six-step sequence in 2/4 meter, similar to Sta Tria footwork.
Allow female dancers to join the line as the dance progresses, maintaining male dancers at both the front and end positions.
teaching.formation: Open chain or circle using a basket-weave (cross) handhold
